program.blurb: Twenty-five minutes a day, a week through every shelf.
program.about: The library in a week, about twenty-five minutes a day. Shoulders and arms, a HIIT EMOM, leg strength, kickboxing, Pilates, a mixed upper-body day and back care take turns. No two neighbouring days load the same muscles. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
